arabic text:
ROZE ASHEERA TABA GHADEER E KHUM MEHFOOZ HAI YEH
MANZAR
ZAAMIN E AZME PAYGHAMBAR THE MISLE ABU TALIB HAIDER
BAAT JAMAL SIFEEN KI HO YA KHANDAQ HO CHAHE KHAYBAR
SHAHE MADINA SHAHE NAJAF KO DETE SADA THE YE KEHKAR
english translation text:
From Ashura to Ghadir-e-Khum, this scene remains
preserved: Haider, like Abu Talib, guaranteed the
Prophet's mission. Whether Jamal, Siffin, Khandaq or
Khaybar, the King of Madina called upon
the King of Najaf with this cry:

arabic text:
BESHAK HAR IMDAD JAHAN ME JANIBE RAB E AKBAR HAI
NAAM MAGAR IMDAD E KHUDA KA GHAUR KARO TO HAIDER HAI
KOI NABI HO KOI WALI HO SAB KA ALI HI YAWAR HAI
ADAM SE QAYIM TAK YEHI BAAT HAR EK KE LAB PER HAI
english translation text:
Without doubt, every help in this world comes from the Lord Most High;
yet when one reflects upon the name of God's help, it is Haider.
Whether prophet or saint, Ali is the helper of all.
From Adam until the Qa'im, this remains upon every tongue.

arabic text:
GHAM YEH MAGAR HAI JISNE SADA IMDAD HAR EK INSAAN KI KI
USKE HI KUNBE KI IMDAD KI KHATIR NA AYA HAI KOI
BETE PE KHANJAR HAI CHALA AUR BETI KI CHADAR NA RAHI
KARKE NAJAF KI SAMT NAZAR DETE THE SADAEIN AALE NABI
english translation text:
The grief is that he who always came to help every human being
found no one to help his own family.
A dagger moved upon his son, and his daughter's veil was taken.
Looking towards Najaf, the Prophet's family continued to call.

arabic text:
AALE NABI KO DARYA PE BHI UMMAT NE PYASA RAKHA
SHAME GHAREEBAN BUGHZE ALI ME GHAR HAI JALAYA ZAHRA KA
DAMAN JALTA THA POTI KA KOI BHUJANE NA AYA
DADA KO DETI THI SADAEI BALI SAKINA HAR LAMHA
english translation text:
The nation kept the Prophet's family thirsty even beside the river.
On the night of loneliness, out of hatred for Ali, Zahra's home was burned.
Her granddaughter's garment was aflame, yet no one came to extinguish it.
Little Sakina called upon her grandfather every moment.

arabic text:
BINTE ALI KO BAZAR O DARBAR PHIRAYA JATA THA
KEHTE THE ZALIM KE LIYA HAI BADR OHAD KA YE BADLA
AAKE TAMASHA AALE NABI KA DEKHLE YE SARI DUNYA
AABID KI AANKHON SE LAHOO KE HAR QATRE NE GIR KE KAHA
english translation text:
Ali's daughter was paraded through the marketplace and court.
The tyrants said this was revenge for Badr and Uhud.
They called the entire world to witness the spectacle of the Prophet's family.
Every drop of blood from Abid's eyes fell and proclaimed:

arabic text:
HUM NE TO SALMAN YEHI AAGHOSH SE MA KI SIKHA HAI
NAAM E ALI HAR MUSHKIL ME HAR EK KO SAHARA DETA HAI
DUNYA TO KYA CHEEZ BHALA YEH QABR BHI ROSHAN KARTA HAI
QABR SE AAGE BARZAKH MEHSHAR YEHI ZABAAN PE REHTA HAI
english translation text:
O Salman, from our mothers' embrace we learned only this:
the name of Ali gives support in every difficulty.
It does not merely help in this world; it illuminates the grave as well.
Beyond the grave, in Barzakh and at Resurrection, this name remains upon the tongue.
